description: This file defines a custom application theme for a Flutter app, including color schemes, theme data configurations for UI components, and background gradients. It encapsulates styling details to maintain a consistent look and feel across the app.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate the app's color scheme and theme data, including background gradients for pages.

methods.name: colorScheme
methods.description: Returns a ColorScheme object with the Ocean Professional palette, including primary, secondary, error, surface, and other related colors.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Provides a ThemeData object configured with the custom color scheme, styles for app bar, cards, snack bars, dialogs, inputs, buttons, and text buttons.

methods.name: pageBackgroundGradient
methods.description: Returns a BoxDecoration with a subtle linear gradient used for page backgrounds.
